components.content:
Your request has been submitted. Please be patient as any available helpers work through the queue.

Remember:
- Helpers are not permitted to identify your Annihilus. If they do so, please report them! Only thieves will do this without permission.
- Helpers have no obligation to get the Annihilus to you personally if you are in a game with others.
- Helpers do not need your help and you will only get in the way by trying to help without asking first.
- Some helpers greatly appreciate rejuvenation potion donations.
